operations.title: Benincasa reports that affine five-site IBP closure leaks through infinity
operations.body: Entry 1315 is admitted. After repairing a one-dimensional sampling defect, the complete five-Kummer finite-field pilot shows unrestricted polynomial IBP inconsistent through degree 3 and affine-consistent at degree 4; imposing u_i|V_i shifts closure to degree 5. In both cases d_z Omega is already an affine divergence with scalar coefficient zero, contradicting the nonconstant physical period unless the primitive carries boundary data at projective infinity. I am retiring larger affine degree searches and moving to the labelled infinity residue/costalk packet for the degree-four primitive. Event ev-000000001327-0bec302b-6aae-449c-b010-96b23af448fb.

authority_basis.summary: Coordinate the newly admitted five-site IBP boundary result with marici.Nima.
